C1.worst_defect: The hero offers four near-equal buttons in one row ('Live demo', 'Quick start', 'Try with your store', 'GitHub'), and the line under them has to explain the difference between 'Quick start' and 'Try with your store'. There is no image of the till anywhere above the fold, so a visitor reads about a POS without ever seeing one.

C2.worst_defect: No page on the site shows the product: there is not a single screenshot of the till, the receipt or the Z report. The only proof that the UI exists is the 'Live demo' link and text claims. Only 2 of the 10 feature cards ('Read the acceptance test', 'Read the 200-send test') link to any evidence.
C2.where: home.desktop.01 feature grid; connect-a-till.desktop.01 ('On Sign in to Vendure, choose Email and password or Device key' with no image)

C3.worst_defect: Step 8 hides the success state. A seven-line paragraph ends 'check Vendure for the POS prices, settled tally-pos payment, delivered fulfilment, stock reduction and tallySaleAt', and the 'Check it worked' list right below repeats the same five checks. On a phone that comes to about two screens of prose before the checklist.
C3.where: quick-start.desktop.03 (8. Sign in and make a sale), quick-start.phone.07-08

C4.worst_defect: Status strings are styled two different ways on one page: the first section puts them in code chips ('N orders waiting to send'), while 'Act on a header notice' sets six error messages as plain quoted text inside long bullets, so the exact on-screen wording does not stand out from the fix. Separately, Overview's 'Next steps' shows a 'Quick start' card and then a full-width 'Quick start >' pager card straight under it.

C5.worst_defect: The home page body is ten identical grey bordered cards in a 5x2 grid running from y 578 to y 1285. There is no icon, image or change in weight, and the first row is taller than the rest because only those two cards carry links. The comparison table below gives the 'Live demo' column about 430 px for one-word 'Yes' cells, while the first column wraps 'Sales reach Vendure, once each, even offline'.

C6.worst_defect: At 390 px the step 6 tax table breaks inline code mid-identifier ('new OrderLevelTax' / 'CalculationStrategy()', 'taxOptions.orderTax' / 'CalculationStrategy') and leaves '(' and ')' stranded around a three-line 'pricesIncludeTax: false' chip. On the home page, the 3-column comparison table squeezes the first column to four lines ('Open and / close a / register with a / Z report'). The hero CTAs wrap into two unequal centred rows of two. Code blocks clip mid-token even for one-liners ('tokenMethod: ['bearer', 'cookie', 'api-key''].

C7.worst_defect: The share card is text only and says the same thing twice: the headline 'Point of sale for Vendure' is followed by 'Open-source point of sale for Vendure...'. Its logo is a hollow pink ring in a pink accent that appears nowhere on the monochrome site. The 404 page also reuses the home meta description, and search snippets return raw backticks and hard line breaks.

overall_worst.defect: On a 390 px phone, the one table a developer must copy from in the quick start (step 6, 'Channel pricing' -> 'taxOptions.orderTaxCalculationStrategy') splits the class names it is there to deliver into two-line fragments ('new OrderLevelTax' / 'CalculationStrategy()') with orphaned parentheses, so the critical config value is hard to read and to copy.
overall_worst.fix: Below about 640 px, render this table as two small labelled code blocks (tax-exclusive / tax-inclusive), or set white-space: nowrap on inline code inside tables and let the table scroll horizontally.
